y_consequential: consequential instability: flips under upstream noise AND the flip is harmful
y_noise: upstream noise (0.4 x embedding RMS), flip in >= half the samples
y_ft_input: fine-tuning flip caused by the router INPUT changing (router weights alone would not flip)
y_harmful: nearest flip raises own loss by > 0.1 nats
y_quant_harmful: flips under quantization AND restoring the clean routing lowers the loss (route-mediated damage)
y_quant_damage_given_flip: among tokens that flipped under quantization: harmful (1) vs harmless (0); the comparison where the router margin failed in arXiv 2608.11212 (AUC 0.49)
